source.name: Escape must close the dropdown menu and return focus to its toggle button
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/35496) at 4fd5539c75515527cb1335c31bbaf76209aab296. Blind to the maintainers' fix c376cb07630f49ae2bbb464925afb3a2dbc5565e; routing auto.

journey.title: Close the invoice actions menu with Escape
journey.goal: Escape closes the menu and focus returns to the toggle

functionalJourney.title: Archive the invoice from the actions menu
functionalJourney.goal: The chosen action runs and the menu closes

guards.title: Choose an action with the keyboard
guards.goal: Arrow keys move through items and Enter runs one

plan.root_cause: Escape key hides the dropdown but does not return focus to the toggle button, leaving focus trapped in the menu.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the _completeHide method to focus the toggle element after hiding the menu, ensuring focus returns to the button that opened the dropdown.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape will close the menu and move focus back to the actions-toggle button, restoring expected keyboard focus order.
functional_risks: Focus may be shifted to the toggle when the menu is hidden via click outside or API calls, which could be unexpected for some use cases.
If the toggle is disabled or detached, focusing could throw an error; however the hide method already checks isDisabled.
verification_requirements: Escape key closes menu (aria-expanded false) and focus returns to #actions-toggle.
ArrowDown opens menu and focuses first menu item.
Clicking a menu item updates last-action and does not break menu functionality.
Keyboard navigation within menu (ArrowUp/ArrowDown, Enter) continues to work.
Menu closes when clicking outside or toggling button again.
